text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling a bit peckish, I bought a sweet red bean bun and some milk, and set off to find a place to eat――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah...! That combination is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching with eyes shining bright was Fenomeno of the disciplinary committee.
Her brisk, sharp stride was reminiscent of a police officer.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Could you be on a stakeout right now?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This officer as well, sir! I am pursuing a suspect who committed the foolish act of pruning the academy's shrubbery into carrot shapes without authorization!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, when it comes to stakeouts,
nothing beats bean buns and milk after all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: During the stakeout scenes in that crowning masterpiece of detective drama, "Howl at the Full Moon!", my heart always pounded with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The nail-biting tension of not knowing when the suspect will appear,
and the gripping arrest that follows once they do――
choice_data_list: Sounds like you won't be able to take your eyes off it.
Sounds like you won't be able to take your eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is that not so? Indeed it is! Ever since I was a child,
I would watch them time and time again, aspiring to be just like them—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Found you, culprit!!
YOU'RE UUUUNDER ARREEEEST!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno dashed ahead with furious momentum.
Rather than a police officer cornering a criminal, she looked more like――
choice_data_list: (Like a "monster" that shows no mercy to evil――)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Target secured!
With this, the peace of the academy has been upheld, sir!

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Dammit alllll!!
And here I thought I was gonna pull off the breakaway!!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-senpai, we'll escort this kid
to the Disciplinary Committee room
and conduct a thorooough interrogation!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I leave it in your hands.
This officer shall rendezvous with you shortly, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, it is nothing.
As a protector of the academy's peace, it is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If you ever run into trouble, please call for me anytime!
I will rush to the scene without delay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno offers a crisp salute, just like a real police officer.
Her earnest demeanor naturally leaves a favorable impression.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it,
weren't you about to do a stakeout too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What are the suspect's physical traits?
Do you have a lead on their location?
This officer shall assist with all her humble might!!
choice_data_list: I'm fine. I can take care of my own things.
Actually, I'm not on a stakeout……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Reluctant to embarrass her by pointing out the misunderstanding, I settle for simply telling her not to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see...
I'm sure you have your own investigation methods, not to mention classified information to protect!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Forgive my tactless intrusion! I sincerely hope the case is resolved soon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno offered a polite, crisp salute.
Seeing her, I couldn't help but think what an earnest girl she truly was.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Still, red bean buns and milk――
choice_data_list: I just bought it because I was a little hungry……

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'M S-S-SOOORRYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I was certain you were a fellow comrade pursuing the suspect—
I even started talking about detective dramas...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I smiled and said it was quite an experience witnessing something straight out of a detective drama, Fenomeno's eyes lit up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I-It is an honor!
Going forward, I intend to throw body and soul
into preserving peace across our academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Fenomeno give such a polite, crisp salute, I felt my own posture straighten up as well.
